report.summary: Build succeeded for esp32s31 with the Board Manager config regenerated; no compile or link errors.

report.flashUsage: app partition 0x380000 (3670016 B); 0xb2c70 (732272 B) = 20% free; bootloader 0x5700 (22272 B), 9% free
notes: Build itself was a no-op incremental (compile 1.7 s, 4 ninja steps — only the size-check bookkeeping and bootloader step reran); the ELF and firmware.bin were already up to date and the image merged cleanly.

Board Manager re-ran its generator for this round: resolved board esp32_s31_korvo_1, validated 8 peripherals and 12 devices, generated Kconfig/board_manager.defaults and gen_bmgr_codes CMakeLists/idf_component.yml, then reported 'bmgr-unchanged' (board unchanged, sdkconfig preserved, board-manager symbols consistent).
Binary shrank by -0 vs previous round's 0x2cd310? No — grew by 128 B (0x2cd310 -> 0x2cd390); partition headroom still 20%.
Ship artifacts produced: merged_flash.bin plus a small delta upload (7 files, 4.1 MB).
report.ramUsage: not reported in build output (no static DRAM/IRAM summary line in log tail)
warnings: Benign, environment-level (not project code): board-manager emits many '⚠️ Duplicate board ... from /opt/esp/board-manager/esp_boards/... overrides previous board from .../managed_components/espressif__esp_boards/...' notices because the system board set shadows the managed-component copy; the correct board (esp32_s31_korvo_1) was resolved and used.

'Warning: Failed to import extension .../managed_components/espressif__esp_board_manager/idf_ext.py: cannot import name 'AmbiguousBoardSelectorError' from 'generators.config_generator'' — version skew between the managed esp_board_manager extension and the system board-manager generator; non-fatal, build completed and config generation succeeded.
Board Manager repeatedly notes board_manager.defaults has higher priority than the project sdkconfig.defaults — relevant if a project-level config setting ever appears not to take effect.
